00029 #define kHxGoodMagic 0xc001c0de
00030 #define kHxBadMagic  0xdeadc0de
00031 
00032 /** 
00033  * @brief                       Validate a "good" magic number
00034  *
00035  * In many Hx and HxUI data structures, we store the value 0xc001c0de
00036  * in a "magic number" field when they are initialized.  This lets the
00037  * APIs do some basic validation to ensure that structures passed in
00038  * have been setup by system code and aren't just random pointers.
00039  *
00040  * @param magic                 IN: magic number to validate
00041  * 
00042  * @return bool: Returns true if magic param is equal to the system
00043  *                              good value, false otherwise.
00044  */
00045 static inline bool HxCheckGoodMagic (uint32_t magic)
00046 {
00047     return (magic == kHxGoodMagic);
00048 }
00049 
00050 /** 
00051  * @brief                       Check for a "bad" magic number
00052  *
00053  * In many Hx and HxUI data structures, we store the value 0xdeadc0de
00054  * in a "magic number" field when the structure is destroyed.
00055  * This lets us detect the use of a freed structure when doing
00056  * data validation.
00057  *
00058  * @param magic                 IN: magic number to validate
00059  * 
00060  * @return bool: Returns true if magic param is equal to the system
00061  *                              bad value, false otherwise.  Note
00062  *                              that being "not bad" doesn't
00063  *                              necessarily make magic "good".
00064  */
00065 static inline bool HxCheckBadMagic (uint32_t magic)
00066 {
00067     return (magic == kHxBadMagic);
00068 }

00070 /** 
00071  * @brief Return string explanation of error code -- meant for
00072  *                              debugging, not presentation to end-users.

00075  * 
00076  * @return const char*:         Returns pointer to string giving a
00077  *                              human-readable short explanation of
00078  *                              the error code passed in.  Note that
00079  *                              not all error codes may have strings
00080  *                              available.  The return value for such
00081  *                              codes is (currently) "Unknown HxResult
00082  *                              0x%x" with %x replaced by the
00083  *                              hexidecimal value of the code.  The
00084  *                              storage for this string may be
00085  *                              overwritten by subsequent calls to
00086  *                              HxResultGetString().  This string is
00087  *                              also not localized; it's always in US
00088  *                              English.
00089  */
00090 const char* HxResultGetString(HxResult result);

00113 /** 
00114  * @brief print params to stderr via fprintf with name of 
00115  *                              calling function prepended with string
00116  *                              "INFO: "
00117  *
00118  * @param ...                   IN: variable; first should be format 
00119  *                              string
00120  */
00121 #define HX_INFO(...)                                                \
00122     do                                                              \
00123     {                                                               \
00124         fprintf(stderr, "INFO: %s(): ", __func__);                  \
00125         fprintf(stderr, __VA_ARGS__);                               \
00126     } while (0)
00127

00173 /** 
00174  * @brief given an expression, if true do nothing, otherwise print
00175  *                              information about where the failure
00176  *                              occurred and drop into the debugger
00177  *                              with a segfault.
00178  *
00179  * @param exp                   IN: expression to assert is true
00180  */
00181 #define HX_ASSERT(exp)                                              \
00182     do                                                              \
00183     {                                                               \
00184         if (false == (exp))                                         \
00185         {                                                           \
00186             HxAssertion(#exp, __func__, __FILE__, __LINE__);        \
00187         }                                                           \
00188     } while (0)                                                     
00189 
00190 /** 
00191  * @brief given an expression and string, do nothing if the expression
00192  *                              is true, otherwise print the string
00193  *                              together with other information about
00194  *                              where the failure occurred.
00195  *
00196  * @param exp                   IN: expression to assert is true
00197  * @param pErrorString          IN: message to print if exp is false
00198  */
00199 #define HX_MESSAGE_IF_ERROR(exp, pErrorString)                      \
00200     do                                                              \
00201     {                                                               \
00202         if (false == (exp))                                         \
00203         {                                                           \
00204             fprintf(stderr, "ERR:  %s(): ", __func__);              \
00205             fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", (pErrorString));                \
00206         }                                                           \
00207     } while (0)
00208

00228 /**
00229  * @brief                     MACRO to goto label with error code 
00230  *                            on failure
00231  *
00232  * @param exp                 IN: expression to check for success
00233  * @param errorVariable       IN: varible of type HxResult.  If not 
00234  *                            already set will be set to HX_FAILURE
00235  * @param label               IN: label to goto if exp is false;
00236  *                            must exist!
00237  */
00238 #define HX_EXIT_IF_ERROR(exp, errorVariable, label)                 \
00239     do                                                              \
00240     {                                                               \
00241         HX_ASSERT(exp);                                             \
00242         if (false == (exp))                                         \
00243         {                                                           \
00244             if (HX_OK == (errorVariable))                           \
00245             {                                                       \
00246                 (errorVariable) = HX_FAILURE;                       \
00247             }                                                       \
00248                                                                     \
00249             goto label;                                             \
00250         }                                                           \
00251     } while (0)
00252 
00253 /**
00254  * @brief                     MACRO to goto label with provided 
00255  *                            error code on failure
00256  *
00257  * @param exp                 IN: expression to check for success
00258  * @param errorVariable       IN: varible of type HxResult
00259  * @param errCode             IN: value to assign to errorVariable
00260  * @param label               IN: label to goto if exp is false;
00261  *                            must exist!
00262  */
00263 #define HX_EXIT_WITH_RESULT(exp, errorVariable, errCode, label)     \
00264     do                                                              \
00265     {                                                               \
00266         HX_ASSERT(exp);                                             \
00267         if (false == (exp))                                         \
00268         {                                                           \
00269             (errorVariable) = (errCode);                            \
00270             goto label;                                             \
00271         }                                                           \
00272     } while (0)

00300 /**
00301  * @brief                      MACRO to validate that a parameter 
00302  *                             is non-null
00303  *
00304  * Use at start of a function with return type of HxResult.  Checks
00305  * exp, and causes the function to return HX_NULL_POINTER if it is
00306  * NULL. Outputs a message for debug builds.
00307  *
00308  * @param exp                   IN: variable to be checked
00309  */
00310 #define HX_NULL_PARAMETER_CHECK(exp)                                \
00311     do                                                              \
00312     {                                                               \
00313         if (exp == NULL)                                            \
00314         {                                                           \
00315             HX_ERROR_MESSAGE("NULL parameter for argument '%s'\n", #exp); \
00316             return HX_NULL_POINTER;                                 \
00317         }                                                           \
00318     } while (0)

00321 /**
00322  * @brief                       MACRO to Check for memory allocation 
00323  *                              error
00324  *
00325  * Check for memory allocation error.  Either pass the affirmation
00326  * (NULL != pointer) for allocators like D_CALLOC, or the affirmation
00327  * (HX_OK == result) for calls like DirectFB's CreateSurface.
00328  *
00329  * @param exp                   IN: expression to be affirmed
00330  */
00331 #define HX_ALLOCATION_ERROR_CHECK(exp)                              \
00332     do                                                              \
00333     {                                                               \
00334         if ((exp) == false)                                         \
00335         {                                                           \
00336             HX_ERROR_MESSAGE("Memory allocation failed\n");         \
00337             return HX_MEMORY_ERROR;                                 \
00338         }                                                           \
00339     } while (0)
